nodes.label: Rule C: bumper-removed data is the hero beat (part off, camera moves in, hold, short factual label)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule c: bumper-removed data is the hero beat (part off, camera moves in, hold, short factual label)
nodes.rationale: User addendum C: the removed-state scan behind the bumper is the richest data, so it gets the longest scene, a held push-in and a label.

nodes.label: C5 lesson: swap to the clean full car on the lock kick
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: c5 lesson: swap to the clean full car on the lock kick
nodes.rationale: The composite base has trim lines / seams; swapping to the clean scan from the same camera on the kick keeps them out of the last frame.

nodes.label: Rule A: deliberate 9:16 framing; opener shows the whole car unclipped with motion from frame 1
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule a: deliberate 9:16 framing; opener shows the whole car unclipped with motion from frame 1
nodes.rationale: Shots that cut the car or part at the frame edge read as accidental clips; check first/middle/last frame of every shot.

nodes.label: Labels name only a captured state or a visible surface; no invented numbers on screen
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: labels name only a captured state or a visible surface; no invented numbers on screen
nodes.rationale: Every label comes from a registered scan file name or something visible in the frame; component names are gated on a verification still.

nodes.label: No repeated views / wasted rotations (ive director IoU flags)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: no repeated views / wasted rotations (ive director iou flags)
nodes.rationale: Turntables and rotating top-downs that repeat the opener's framing add no data; ive director flags repeated silhouettes and dead frames.

nodes.label: Rule B: each section appears in ONE continuous sequence (no ping-pong)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule b: each section appears in one continuous sequence (no ping-pong)
nodes.rationale: User addendum: a section must never be revisited; travel goes front, side, rear with no return.

nodes.label: Rule D: open/removed states only where a registered state scan exists (no faked openings)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule d: open/removed states only where a registered state scan exists (no faked openings)
nodes.rationale: Animating a closed scan open, or lifting a part with no removed-state scan, exposes holes and implies a capture that does not exist (honda-civic-11 / honda-s2000 lessons).

nodes.label: Rule: order scenes by scan features (feature inventory -> scene order)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule: order scenes by scan features (feature inventory -> scene order)
nodes.rationale: User rule: inventory which regions carry registered states/parts; the richest region gets the longest scene and the biggest musical moment; travel front -> side -> rear.

nodes.label: Temerario order: progressive explode -> wide -> reassembly
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: temerario order: progressive explode -> wide -> reassembly
nodes.rationale: Never separate every part at once in one wide orbit; remove parts section by section, close, then one wide reassembly locking on a strong kick.

nodes.label: Rule 7: end with reassembly, fade, then a SMALL logo
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: rule 7: end with reassembly, fade, then a small logo
nodes.rationale: Temerario reference: logo about 25-35 % of the width, short; v1 logo cards (~75-78 % width) were too big and held too long.

nodes.label: Two-stage planning: scene-director (stage 1 order) -> director (stage 2 shot plan)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: two-stage planning: scene-director (stage 1 order) -> director (stage 2 shot plan)
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 fixes scene order from the feature inventory; stage 2 adds camera, part keys, hold list and render budget without reordering.

nodes.label: Flip a part about its width axis (never a Z-spin), and only when its backside is scanned
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: flip a part about its width axis (never a z-spin), and only when its backside is scanned
nodes.rationale: 240SX / A90 lessons: a Z-spin shows nothing; a tip about the width axis turns the scanned inner face to the lens. Unverified backsides are translate-only.

nodes.label: Render 3 spare frames per shot to cover the minterpolate tail
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: render 3 spare frames per shot to cover the minterpolate tail
nodes.rationale: seconds = dur + 0.2 at 15 fps so interpolation never clones the last frame.

nodes.label: Removed parts move into clear black background, never across the body
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: removed parts move into clear black background, never across the body
nodes.rationale: A silver part over the silver body does not read (Miata NA lesson); move forward/toward the lens first, then up or down, with bbox clearance checks.

nodes.label: Persistent data OFF for keyed parts + per-frame luma scan of every render
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: persistent data off for keyed parts + per-frame luma scan of every render
nodes.rationale: Persistent-data dropout lesson (G35 / Ferrari / Cappuccino): animated parts render black frames with persistent data on.

nodes.label: Verification still decides the behind-bumper label wording
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: verification still decides the behind-bumper label wording
nodes.rationale: Do not name a part you cannot point to in a full-resolution still; fallback sub-label 'AS SCANNED' names no part.

nodes.label: Cut on the measured kick of the decoded audio (within half a frame)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: cut on the measured kick of the decoded audio (within half a frame)
nodes.rationale: Grid times can sit a frame off the real onset (C5 / FG2 / GR86 lessons); verify on the delivered file and move the music, not the cut.

nodes.label: WRX VB v2 binding rules relayed from the user
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: wrx vb v2 binding rules relayed from the user
nodes.rationale: Front-side-rear travel, one sequence per section, camera stays on a section when a part comes off and shows its inner face, whole-car opener, bumper-removed hero with factual labels, no faked openings, reassembly + fade + small logo, render budget ~2.5 h.

nodes.label: Feedback C overrides the 'no text' brief: short factual labels
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: feedback c overrides the 'no text' brief: short factual labels
nodes.rationale: Follow-up user feedback A-D wins over the original 9-point brief; confirmed labels vs conditional labels (EXHAUST, CRASH BEAM, WIRING) gated on the new close-up frame.

nodes.label: Hinged lids swing to the CAPTURED angle (hood -52.0 deg, trunk +62.9 deg)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: hinged lids swing to the captured angle (hood -52.0 deg, trunk +62.9 deg)
nodes.rationale: Feedback D: lids are cut from the full-car skin and swing on the axis fitted to the lid sliver of the registered open-state scan; showing states 'as captured' would show a missing lid, implying a removed-lid state never scanned. Frame so the unscanned underside is edge-on.

nodes.label: No brand names on screen (no file says Jackson Racing or CSF)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: no brand names on screen (no file says jackson racing or csf)
nodes.rationale: The parent mapped the user's wording to the May 2023 underbody folder; no folder or file names a brand, so nothing is claimed until the user confirms.

nodes.label: User feedback on v2: add the front under-bumper data ('Jackson Racing or CSF') and apply lessons from the other videos
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: user feedback on v2: add the front under-bumper data ('jackson racing or csf') and apply lessons from the other videos
nodes.rationale: User: 'we have a significant amount of underbumper data in the front... please add that. also take what you learned from the other videos, and apply it here.'

nodes.label: HUD fix: counter 14,999,997 replaced by a label (ScanHUD counter stops at 99.9 %)
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
nodes.norm_label: hud fix: counter 14,999,997 replaced by a label (scanhud counter stops at 99.9 %)
nodes.rationale: Sera/C5 lesson: the counter animation would end on ~14,985,351, a wrong number; numbers come from STL headers.

nodes.label: Director 'repeated view' flags reviewed by eye and kept
nodes.community_name: Director Tool, HUD and Explode Rules
